GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shortly after the start shifted out and was bumped. Rider reported that his mount travelled well throughout the event albeit racing wide. He added that his mount initially responded to his riding in the early parts of the straight, however, passing the 200m failed to respond to his riding and did not finish the event off strongly. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.
